drafts.walkScript: Lines 48 and 49 say a door was mistaken "In the agitation and half darkness". Line 4 says "We're in the new house"; lines 53 and 54 show a missed supper. A mistaken door and a missed supper show an upset, muddled arrival after dark. So "agitation" means "the upset and muddle of arriving late at night". The darkness is the time, not the feeling; nothing is stirred, and the room comes later.
